Terms of service

Payment

We accept Credit Card, Debit Card payments via PayPal and Stripe.
Goods will not be dispatched until the customer’s funds, which have been paid to Ingenious Laboratories Limited, have cleared in full.

Orders

Please note that all transactions will be carried out in pounds sterling.
Once you have placed your order, confirmation will be sent to you via e-mail complete with Transaction and Order Reference numbers.
We will not be held responsible for pricing errors due to software mal-functions, or human error.
This website operates on an ‘invitation to treat’ basis and not as an ‘offer for sale’, as a result Ingenious Laboratories Limited reserves the right to decline orders for bulk or high value purchases.

Subscription Orders

Monthly/Quarterly subscriptions, which are on automatic payment, will be processed on the due date.

Subscription Suspension & Cancellation

Monthly/Quarterly subscriptions can be suspended or cancelled at any time via the My Account link on the FeelIngenious website.

Dispatch

All orders received before 12:00 on a working day will be processed that day. Orders received after 12:00 will be processed on the following working day.

Delivery

Ingenious partners with third-party courier services to deliver your orders. Estimated delivery times are provided for guidance only and are not guaranteed. Ingenious is not liable for delays caused by couriers or circumstances beyond our control.

Delivery Updates and Responsibility:

  • It is the customer’s responsibility to monitor delivery updates sent by the courier (e.g., tracking emails or SMS text messages).
  • If you are unavailable to receive your order, it is your responsibility to make arrangements with the courier to reschedule delivery or update delivery preferences.

Safe Place Deliveries:

  • By placing an order, you acknowledge that the courier may leave your parcel in a safe place if you are not available to accept delivery.
  • If you do not wish for your parcel to be left in a safe place, it is your responsibility to notify the courier directly using the options provided in their delivery notifications.

Missing Orders:

  • Ingenious is not liable for claims of missing orders where the courier tracking indicates the order has been delivered.
  • Customers claiming non-receipt of a delivered order must provide a signed Denial of Receipt Form to support their claim, which will be investigated in conjunction with the courier.
  • Refunds or replacements will only be issued where the investigation determines the parcel was not delivered to the stated address or left in an inappropriate location.

Limitation of Liability

Ingenious is not liable for:

  • Any losses arising from delays or failed deliveries caused by courier services or circumstances beyond our control.
  • Missing orders marked as delivered by the courier, where the delivery adheres to the courier’s policies and standards.
  • Indirect, incidental, or consequential damages related to your purchase or use of our products.

Customer Obligations

By placing an order, you agree to:

  • Provide accurate delivery and contact information.
  • Monitor courier updates and take reasonable steps to ensure successful receipt of your parcel.
  • Report any issues with your order within 14 days of the delivery date.

Gift Cards

Gift cards can only be purchased by customers in the UK. Gift cards are valid for 1 year (365 days) from the date of purchase.

Credit Card Security

At this stage, you will be passed on to a Secure Order Processing page, your details will be encrypted by 128-bit industry-standard Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) technology to provide encryption of personal information such as your name, address and credit card details.

Privacy Policy

  • We collect only the basic personal details, to allow us to carry out our fundamental business activities of fulfilling orders and maintaining customer relationships.
  • We only share personal details with third parties where it is essential, to carry out these activities: process orders; undertake on-going customer communication and support; and carry out product development and market research.
  • We do not store credit card details nor do we share customer details with 3rd parties for any other purpose.
  • As a matter of company policy we guarantee not to trade, sell, resell, or redistribute information that you provide to us to any other company, organisation, or individual.
  • All our marketing emails contain an opt out link which will stop further emails being sent. If you wish to opt out of all communication including email, telephone, and direct mail please email: hello@ingeniouslife.com requesting a full opt out.

Returns Policy

For most products bought online, you have the legal right under the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013 to change your mind within the 14 day Cooling-Off period and receive a refund.

As our collagen products are an ingestible supplement, the right to change your mind does not apply, and we cannot accept returns due to quality control, and health & safety. We take great care in producing our collagen and cannot re-stock food products once they have left our control.

Subject to these terms and conditions, we are, of course, able to accept returns if we have processed your order in error – or if we have failed to action your request (provided it was before Midnight, the day before your upcoming order date). If you’re concerned that your product is damaged, in this instance, please get in touch via the contact page and we can assist you with the matter and issue a refund where applicable.

Unlawful or Prohibited Use

You shall not use this site for any purpose that is unlawful or by any means prohibited under the terms and conditions.
You shall not use this site in any manner, which may harm Ingenious Laboratories Limited or other parties or adversely affect the site functionality or its use by others.
You shall not attempt or obtain from or through this site any information that is not already and intentionally made available from or through it.

Web Site Terms of Use

All the information on this web site is intended for guidance only. The web site is regularly updated. Products and prices are subject to change without notice. Ingenious Laboratories Limited owns the copyright in all materials on this site.

Copyright

All contents and information on this site including without limitation text, graphic and images, is the property of Ingenious Laboratories Limited or the property of their respective owners and is protected by United Kingdom copyright laws.

Trademarks

All trademarks that appear on this site are the property of their respective owners.
